instruction: Implement `pub fn is_balanced(s: &str) -> bool` in the target file, replacing the stub. It returns true iff every bracket in `s` is correctly matched and nested across the three bracket kinds `()`, `[]`, `{}`. Non-bracket characters are ignored. The empty string is balanced. Examples: is_balanced("()")=true, is_balanced("()[]{}")=true, is_balanced("{[]}")=true, is_balanced("(]")=false, is_balanced("([)]")=false, is_balanced("(")=false. Edit only this file.
